subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on A Garments Worker in around
stimulus: 250 words answering the following questions. 10 (a) Who is a garments worker? (b) Who are generally working in our garments industry? (c) How is their working condition? (d) How does this affect their health? (e) What can you suggest to improve the life of garments workers?'
guide_solution: Paragraph writing A Garments Worker A garment worker is generally a woman who works in a garment factory to earn her living. Here working environment is not at all congenial and healthy. But she works there from morning till evening. Sometimes she works the whole night and even on holydays. In spite of her hard labour, she earns a little with which she can hardly meet up her daily need. Her social status is not high. But she is contributing a lot to our national economy. The garment sector earns about half of our total export earning. So she plays an important role in developing our country by the sweat of her brow. Our women are also doing many other jobs like poultry, cattle rearing, teaching, banking and even as day labourers in construction companies. They are also doing successful jobs in administration. About 50 per cent of our population is women. So, the country cannot be developed without the participation of our women folk. The first and foremost thing to ensure their participation in all development activities is to make a congenial and indiscriminant atmosphere in the places where they work. In the recent years, many garment workers have become the victims of many accidents in garment factories. Of them, Savar tragedy is most serious. It has taken away many lives. So, naturally now garment workers work in a fearful state. So, the government and the authority concerned must take proper steps in this regard so that mishaps never repeat in future. Moreover, their income is much less in proportion to their toil. So, they should be sympathetically considered so that they can lead on the whole a comfortable and decent life.
